description: This file defines a React functional component 'NotesList' that displays a list of notes with features such as search, pagination, deletion, and loading skeletons. It interacts with external API services to fetch and delete notes.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Fetches notes from the API based on current page, page size, and search parameters.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a note by ID, with user confirmation and API call.
